integrity: Theorem proved by exact gap and pseudo-Frobenius interval analysis; a standalone Apéry-based checker corroborated all 10857 eligible parameter triples through e=48. No independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes k>=3, e>=2k+1 and an interior consecutive deletion block j..j+k-1. Does not determine intermediate Betti numbers or arbitrary deletion patterns; finite verification only supplements a general proof. Equivalence in unindexed literature remains a risk.
title: Pseudo-Frobenius spectra for consecutive-deletion Sally numerical semigroups
